outcome: Transfusion of ≥5 units of packed red blood cells (PRBCs) during cesarean section
cohort: 287 women with placenta previa who delivered between September 2011 and April 2018
finding: A scoring model incorporating maternal age, degree of previa, grade of lacunae, presence of a hypoechoic layer, and anterior placentation effectively predicted the need for transfusion of ≥5 units of PRBCs during cesarean section in women with placenta previa.
mod_finding: The abstract focuses on predicting the need for massive transfusion during cesarean section in women with placenta previa.
